verdict.rationale: Google Cloud ships an official, documented CLI, `gcloud`. It has install and initialization docs and a full command reference covering authentication, configuration, developer workflow and Google Cloud API interactions. A community user running `gcloud container clusters get-credentials` corroborates real-world use; that report concerns a platform outage, not a CLI defect. missing for 10: evidence of agent-oriented CLI features such as structured or machine-readable output and non-interactive scripting guidance for AI workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: The `gcloud` CLI manages authentication, local configuration, developer workflow, and interactions with the Google Cloud APIs.
This quickstart describes the recommended method to install and initialize the Google Cloud CLI.
gcloud - manage Google Cloud resources and developer workflow
